title: Remote PC HTTPS gateway boundary
summary: Extended My PC to accept a secure HTTPS gateway origin while preserving the local bridge policy and documenting the cloud signaling and TURN requirements for worldwide access.

changes.detail: Accept default-port HTTPS gateway origins without credentials, queries, alternate ports or paths; retain private HTTP port 6081 only for local use.
Update mobile copy and placeholder to distinguish local trusted Wi-Fi from a future authenticated remote gateway.
Document the required outbound host agent, signaling, WebRTC, TURN, MFA, revocation and audit architecture; explicitly prohibit public exposure of the local bridge.

validation.name: URL policy tests
validation.detail: Local, HTTPS, unsafe scheme, credential, path, query and port cases passed.

validation.detail: The existing jsdom interaction test ended with Array buffer allocation failed during the transpiled component run; no successful interaction result is claimed.
